First, note the given date is in MM-DD-YYYY: 04-21-2014.  
332 days before April 21, 2014:  

2014 is not a leap year (2014 ÷ 4 = 503.5).  
Days back from April 21, 2014:  
April 21 → March 31 = 21 days back (332 - 21 = 311 left).  
March has 31 days, so back to March 1 = another 30 days (311 - 30 = 281 left).  
February 2014 has 28 days → 281 - 28 = 253 left.  
January 2014 has 31 days → 253 - 31 = 222 left.  
Now in December 2013 (31 days) → 222 - 31 = 191 left.  
November 2013 (30 days) → 191 - 30 = 161 left.  
October 2013 (31 days) → 161 - 31 = 130 left.  
September 2013 (30 days) → 130 - 30 = 100 left.  
August 2013 (31 days) → 100 - 31 = 69 left.  
July 2013 (31 days) → 69 - 31 = 38 left.  
June 2013 (30 days) → 38 - 30 = 8 left.  
May 2013 has 31 days, so 8 days before June 1 is May 24 (since May 31 → 1 day back = May 30, etc.).  

Check: From May 24, 2013 to April 21, 2014:  
May 24–May 31 = 7 days, June 2013 = 30, July = 31, Aug = 31, Sept = 30, Oct = 31, Nov = 30, Dec = 31, Jan 2014 = 31, Feb = 28, Mar = 31, Apr 1–21 = 21 days.  
Sum: 7+30+31+31+30+31+30+31+31+28+31+21 = 332 days.
